I answered Tobias in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

- **Source:** I checked GBrain, then read #inc-tansley-carrier-api itself, which Tobias is a member of. Pree posted on 3 Sep 2025 that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that "Southgate dispatch has totes stacked beside door 4." Her closing message at 18:43 says Southgate had cleared the backlog.
- **No address:** The messages only give the site name. I told Tobias that Pree or the account profile would have the street address.
